svg.title: GambaWatch NT
svg.desc: A likelihood map of gamba grass. An aerial survey inside gamba country marks cells where gamba was and wasn't found, and the map scores both alike: AUC 0.54.

g.text: AUC 0.54, where 0.5 is a coin toss
Likely gamba grass at 20 m, Darwin to Litchfield

svg.text: A 20 m satellite map of likely gamba grass. Tested on 27,469
recorded absences, it finds gamba country, not the grass itself.
Earth Engine, Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, MODIS, gradient boosting.
